summary: Top Ships Inc. filed a 6-K reporting two related-party vessel transactions. On July 28, 2026, it signed a Share Purchase Agreement with Central Mare Inc. (seller, affiliated with the Pistiolis family) to acquire all shares of three SPVs, each holding a shipbuilding contract for a 49,940 dwt MR chemical/product oil tanker from HD Hyundai-Vietnam. Purchase price is ~$4.7 million (net of $2.6M cash and $23.5M credit from a cancelled Dubai acquisition), payable by September 30, 2026. The vessels deliver July-October 2029 and have five-year charters with a major oil trader (~$140.6M backlog). A special committee approved the deal with a fairness opinion. The registrant is the acquirer; watch for financing-related payment obligations before closing.
